etymology: 拉丁语 initiare，意为"开始"

example_en: The nurse injected the medicine into the patient's arm.
example_cn: 护士将药物注射到患者的手臂中。
etymology: 拉丁语 inicere，意为"投入"

example_en: Technological innovation drives economic growth.
example_cn: 技术创新推动经济增长。
etymology: 拉丁语 innovare，意为"更新"

example_en: There are innumerable stars in the night sky.
example_cn: 夜空中有无数的星星。
etymology: 拉丁语 innumerabilis，意为"数不清的"

example_en: I would like to inquire about the availability of the room.
example_cn: 我想询问房间是否可用。
etymology: 拉丁语 inquirere，意为"寻求"

example_en: It would be insane to attempt the journey without preparation.
example_cn: 不加准备就尝试这趟旅程是疯狂的。
etymology: 拉丁语 insanus，意为"不健全的"

meaning: v. 插入 n. 插页
example_en: Please insert the coin into the slot to start the machine.
example_cn: 请将硬币插入投币口启动机器。
etymology: 拉丁语 inserere，意为"放入"

example_en: The book provides valuable insights into human behavior.
example_cn: 这本书对人类行为提供了有价值的见解。
etymology: 中古英语 insight，意为"内视"

example_en: Health inspectors visited the restaurant to check hygiene standards.
example_cn: 卫生检查员视察了这家餐厅的卫生标准。
etymology: 拉丁语 inspectare，意为"仔细看"

example_en: Nature has always been a source of inspiration for artists.
example_cn: 大自然一直是艺术家的灵感之源。
etymology: 拉丁语 inspirare，意为"吹入；激励"

example_en: The explosion was almost instantaneous when the gas leaked.
example_cn: 气体泄漏时爆炸几乎是瞬间发生的。
etymology: 拉丁语 instans，意为"在场的；即时的"

example_en: Her instinct told her that something was wrong.
example_cn: 她的直觉告诉她出了问题。
etymology: 拉丁语 instinctus，意为"冲动；本能"

meaning: n. 学院；研究所 v. 制定
example_en: She works at a research institute focusing on climate change.
example_cn: 她在一家专注于气候变化的研究所工作。
etymology: 拉丁语 instituere，意为"设立"

example_en: His leadership was instrumental in the success of the project.
example_cn: 他的领导对该项目的成功起了关键作用。
etymology: 拉丁语 instrumentum，意为"工具"

example_en: The walls are insulated to keep the house warm in winter.
example_cn: 墙壁有隔热层，使房子在冬天保持温暖。
etymology: 拉丁语 insula，意为"岛屿"

example_en: The ancient building remained intact after the earthquake.
example_cn: 这座古建筑在地震后依然完好。
etymology: 拉丁语 intactus，意为"未触碰的"

example_en: Communication is an integral part of any relationship.
example_cn: 沟通是任何关系中不可或缺的一部分。
etymology: 拉丁语 integer，意为"完整的"

example_en: The school aims to integrate technology into everyday learning.
example_cn: 学校旨在将技术融入日常学习。
etymology: 拉丁语 integrare，意为"使完整"

example_en: A politician should have personal integrity and honesty.
example_cn: 政治家应该具有正直和诚实的品格。
etymology: 拉丁语 integer，意为"完整的；正直的"

meaning: adj. 智力的 n. 知识分子
example_en: The university fosters intellectual growth and critical thinking.
example_cn: 大学促进智力成长和批判性思维。
etymology: 拉丁语 intellectus，意为"理解力"

example_en: The competition between the two companies has intensified.
example_cn: 两家公司之间的竞争加剧了。
etymology: 拉丁语 intensio，意为"拉紧"

example_en: She attended an intensive language course during the summer.
example_cn: 她夏天参加了一个密集的语言课程。
etymology: 拉丁语 intendere，意为"伸展；集中"

example_en: Students interact with each other through group projects.
example_cn: 学生通过小组项目相互互动。
etymology: 拉丁语 inter + agere，意为"互相作用"

example_en: The intelligence agency intercepted the enemy's communications.
example_cn: 情报机构截获了敌方的通信。
etymology: 拉丁语 intercipere，意为"中途截取"

example_en: Please do not interfere with the ongoing investigation.
example_cn: 请不要干涉正在进行的调查。
etymology: 拉丁语 inter + ferire，意为"之间打击"

distinction.diff: interfere 带贬义，指不该管的事；intervene 较中性，指介入调解

meaning: n. 过渡期 adj. 临时的
example_en: An interim government was established during the transition.
example_cn: 过渡期间成立了临时政府。
etymology: 拉丁语 interim，意为"在此期间"

meaning: n. 内部 adj. 内部的
example_en: The interior of the cathedral is decorated with beautiful paintings.
example_cn: 大教堂内部装饰着美丽的画作。
etymology: 拉丁语 interior，意为"更里面的"

example_en: The textbook is designed for intermediate learners of English.
example_cn: 这本教材为中级英语学习者设计。
etymology: 拉丁语 intermedius，意为"中间的"

example_en: The company conducted an internal audit of its finances.
example_cn: 公司对其财务进行了内部审计。
etymology: 拉丁语 internus，意为"内部的"

example_en: It is difficult to interpret the ancient text accurately.
example_cn: 准确解读这篇古文很困难。
etymology: 拉丁语 interpretari，意为"解释"

example_en: The government decided to intervene to stabilize the economy.
example_cn: 政府决定干预以稳定经济。
etymology: 拉丁语 intervenire，意为"来到中间"

meaning: adj. 亲密的；私人的 v. 暗示
example_en: They shared an intimate conversation by the fireplace.
example_cn: 他们在壁炉旁进行了一次亲密的交谈。
etymology: 拉丁语 intimare，意为"使亲密"

example_en: The bully tried to intimidate the smaller children.
example_cn: 恶霸试图恐吓较小的孩子。
etymology: 拉丁语 intimidare，意为"使恐惧"

example_en: The intricate design of the watch requires skilled craftsmanship.
example_cn: 手表的精细设计需要熟练的工艺。
etymology: 拉丁语 intricare，意为"纠缠"

example_en: The painting has intrinsic value beyond its market price.
example_cn: 这幅画具有超越市场价格的内在价值。
etymology: 拉丁语 intrinsecus，意为"向内"

example_en: The army invaded the neighboring country at dawn.
example_cn: 军队在黎明时入侵了邻国。
etymology: 拉丁语 invadere，意为"进入；攻击"

meaning: adj. 无效的；有病的 n. 病人
example_en: The ticket is invalid after the expiration date.
example_cn: 过期后这张票就无效了。
etymology: 拉丁语 invalidus，意为"虚弱的；无效的"

example_en: Her experience proved invaluable during the crisis.
example_cn: 她的经验在危机中证明是无价的。
etymology: 拉丁语 in- + valuable，意为"无法估价的"

distinction.diff: invaluable 意为极其宝贵的；valueless 意为毫无价值的

example_en: The store needs to update its inventory records.
example_cn: 商店需要更新库存记录。
etymology: 拉丁语 inventarium，意为"发现清单"

example_en: She inverted the image to create a mirror effect.
example_cn: 她将图像倒置以创建镜像效果。
etymology: 拉丁语 invertere，意为"翻转"

meaning: adj. 无敌的；不可战胜的
example_en: The team seemed invincible throughout the season.
example_cn: 这支球队在整个赛季似乎不可战胜。
etymology: 拉丁语 invincibilis，意为"不可征服的"

example_en: The lawyer invoked the Fifth Amendment in court.
example_cn: 律师在法庭上援引了第五修正案。
etymology: 拉丁语 invocare，意为"呼唤"

example_en: His fear of flying is completely irrational.
example_cn: 他对飞行的恐惧是完全不理性的。
etymology: 拉丁语 irrationalis，意为"无理性的"

meaning: adj. 不可逆的；不能撤回的
example_en: Climate change could cause irreversible damage to the environment.
example_cn: 气候变化可能对环境造成不可逆的损害。
etymology: 拉丁语 irreversibilis，意为"不可反转的"

example_en: Farmers irrigate their fields with water from the river.
example_cn: 农民用河水灌溉田地。
etymology: 拉丁语 irrigare，意为"浇灌"

example_en: His constant complaining irritated his coworkers.
example_cn: 他不停地抱怨激怒了同事。
etymology: 拉丁语 irritare，意为"刺激；激怒"

example_en: The patient was isolated to prevent the spread of infection.
example_cn: 患者被隔离以防止感染扩散。
etymology: 拉丁语 insula，意为"岛屿"

example_en: We need to finalize our itinerary before the trip.
example_cn: 我们需要在旅行前确定行程。
etymology: 拉丁语 itinerarium，意为"旅程记录"

example_en: His reckless behavior could jeopardize the entire project.
example_cn: 他的鲁莽行为可能会危及整个项目。
etymology: 法语 jeu parti，意为"平局"，后引申为危险

example_en: The accident happened at the junction of two major highways.
example_cn: 事故发生在两条主要公路的交叉口。
etymology: 拉丁语 jungere，意为"连接"

example_en: The case falls under the jurisdiction of the federal court.
example_cn: 此案属于联邦法院的管辖范围。
etymology: 拉丁语 juris + dictio，意为"法律之言"

meaning: adj. 青少年的 n. 青少年
example_en: Juvenile crime rates have decreased in recent years.
example_cn: 近年来青少年犯罪率有所下降。
etymology: 拉丁语 juvenilis，意为"年轻的"

example_en: She is keen to learn new skills and advance her career.
example_cn: 她渴望学习新技能并推进自己的事业。
etymology: 古英语 cene，意为"勇敢的；锋利的"

example_en: The wealthy businessman was kidnapped and held for ransom.
example_cn: 那位富商被绑架并被索要赎金。
etymology: kid + nap（抓），意为"偷小孩"

meaning: n. 标签 v. 标注
example_en: Please read the label before taking the medicine.
example_cn: 服药前请阅读标签。
etymology: 法语 label，意为"绦带"，后指标签

example_en: Economic growth in the region has lagged behind the national average.
example_cn: 该地区的经济增长落后于全国平均水平。
etymology: 中古英语 lag，意为"延迟"

example_en: The court ruling was a landmark decision for civil rights.
example_cn: 法院的裁决是民权领域的一个里程碑式决定。
etymology: 由 land + mark 组成

example_en: The political landscape has changed dramatically in recent years.
example_cn: 近年来政治格局发生了巨大变化。
etymology: 荷兰语 landschap，意为"地区风景"

meaning: n. 失误；流逝 v. 失效
example_en: A momentary lapse in concentration caused the accident.
example_cn: 一瞬间的注意力不集中导致了事故。
etymology: 拉丁语 labi，意为"滑落"

example_en: The company encouraged lateral thinking to solve the problem.
example_cn: 公司鼓励横向思维来解决问题。
etymology: 拉丁语 lateralis，意为"侧面的"

meaning: adj. 奢华的 v. 慷慨给予
example_en: The hotel offers lavish accommodations for its guests.
example_cn: 这家酒店为客人提供奢华的住宿。
etymology: 拉丁语 lavare，意为"洗"，原指大量用水

meaning: n. 层 v. 分层放置
example_en: A thick layer of snow covered the entire city.
example_cn: 厚厚的一层雪覆盖了整座城市。
etymology: 古英语 lagu，意为"层"

example_en: The layout of the new office promotes collaboration.
example_cn: 新办公室的布局促进了协作。
etymology: 由 lay + out 组成

meaning: n. 杠杆作用；影响力 v. 利用
example_en: The company leveraged its brand reputation to enter new markets.
example_cn: 公司利用品牌声誉进入新市场。
etymology: 法语 levier，意为"杠杆"

meaning: v. 征收 n. 征税
example_en: The government levied a new tax on imported goods.
example_cn: 政府对进口商品征收新税。
etymology: 法语 lever，意为"举起"

example_en: The company is liable for any damage caused by its products.
example_cn: 公司对其产品造成的任何损害负有责任。
etymology: 法语 lier，意为"绑定"

distinction.diff: liable 常涉及法律赔偿；responsible 范围更广

example_en: The university has a liberal policy on course selection.
example_cn: 大学对课程选择实行自由的政策。
etymology: 拉丁语 liberalis，意为"自由的；高贵的"

example_en: The army liberated the city from enemy occupation.
example_cn: 军队将城市从敌人占领中解放出来。
etymology: 拉丁语 liberare，意为"释放"

example_en: There is a high likelihood of rain this afternoon.
example_cn: 今天下午下雨的可能性很大。
etymology: 古英语 lic（身体/形态）+ hood，like + lihood

example_en: The smell of freshly baked bread lingered in the kitchen.
example_cn: 新鲜面包的香味在厨房里久久不散。
etymology: 古英语 lengan，意为"延长"

example_en: Please do not take my words in a literal sense.
example_cn: 请不要从字面上理解我的话。
etymology: 拉丁语 littera，意为"字母"

meaning: n. 垃圾；一窝 v. 乱扔
example_en: Please do not litter in the public park.
example_cn: 请不要在公园里乱扔垃圾。
etymology: 拉丁语 lectus，意为"床"，后指散落的东西

example_en: Fishing is the main livelihood for the coastal community.
example_cn: 捕鱼是沿海社区的主要生计。
etymology: 古英语 liflad，意为"生活方式"

example_en: The luminous dial of the watch glowed in the dark.
example_cn: 手表的发光表盘在黑暗中发光。
etymology: 拉丁语 lumen，意为"光"

meaning: v. 引诱 n. 诱惑
example_en: The company used high salaries to lure top talent.
example_cn: 公司用高薪吸引顶尖人才。
etymology: 法语 loerre，意为"诱饵"

example_en: A vacation abroad is a luxury many cannot afford.
example_cn: 出国度假是许多人负担不起的奢侈。
etymology: 拉丁语 luxus，意为"过剩；奢侈"

meaning: n. 地方法官；治安法官
example_en: The magistrate sentenced the offender to community service.
example_cn: 地方法官判处违法者社区服务。
etymology: 拉丁语 magistratus，意为"官长"

meaning: adj. 磁性的；有吸引力的
example_en: She has a magnetic personality that draws people to her.
example_cn: 她有一种吸引人的魅力。
etymology: 希腊语 Magnesia，一种磁性矿石的产地

example_en: The view from the mountaintop was truly magnificent.
example_cn: 从山顶看到的景色确实壮观。
etymology: 拉丁语 magnificus，意为"伟大的"

example_en: The magnitude of the earthquake was 7.2 on the Richter scale.
example_cn: 地震的震级为里氏7.2级。
etymology: 拉丁语 magnitudo，意为"巨大"

example_en: The general planned a clever maneuver to outflank the enemy.
example_cn: 将军策划了一个巧妙的策略来侧翼包抄敌人。
etymology: 法语 manoeuvre，意为"手工操作"

meaning: adj. 明显的 v. 显示；表明
example_en: Her anger was manifest in her trembling voice.
example_cn: 她的愤怒在颤抖的声音中显露出来。
etymology: 拉丁语 manifestus，意为"明显的"

example_en: He was accused of manipulating the financial data.
example_cn: 他被指控操纵财务数据。
etymology: 拉丁语 manipulus，意为"一把"，后引申为操控

example_en: The author submitted the manuscript to the publisher last week.
example_cn: 作者上周将手稿提交给了出版商。
etymology: 拉丁语 manuscriptus，意为"手写的"

example_en: The company's profit margin has increased this quarter.
example_cn: 公司本季度的利润率有所增长。
etymology: 拉丁语 marginem，意为"边缘"

meaning: adj. 边缘的；微不足道的
example_en: The improvement in sales was only marginal.
example_cn: 销售额的改善微乎其微。
etymology: 源自 margin，意为"边缘的"

meaning: adj. 海洋的；航海的 n. 海军陆战队
example_en: Marine life is threatened by pollution and overfishing.
example_cn: 海洋生物受到污染和过度捕捞的威胁。
etymology: 拉丁语 mare，意为"海"

example_en: The decor of the room had a very masculine feel.
example_cn: 房间的装饰有一种非常阳刚的感觉。
etymology: 拉丁语 masculinus，意为"男性的"

example_en: The earthquake caused massive destruction in the city.
example_cn: 地震在城市中造成了巨大的破坏。
etymology: 拉丁语 massa，意为"团块"

example_en: The UN attempted to mediate between the two warring nations.
example_cn: 联合国试图在两个交战国之间进行调解。
etymology: 拉丁语 mediare，意为"居于中间"

example_en: The medieval castle has been beautifully preserved.
example_cn: 这座中世纪城堡保存得非常完好。
etymology: 拉丁语 medium aevum，意为"中间时代"

example_en: The melody of the old song brought back fond memories.
example_cn: 那首老歌的旋律唤起了美好的回忆。
etymology: 希腊语 melōidia，意为"歌唱"

example_en: The manager sent a memorandum to all employees about the new policy.
example_cn: 经理向全体员工发送了关于新政策的备忘录。
etymology: 拉丁语 memorare，意为"记住"

meaning: n. 威胁 v. 威胁
example_en: Drunk driving is a menace to public safety.
example_cn: 醉酒驾车是对公共安全的威胁。
etymology: 法语 menace，意为"威胁"

example_en: She was grateful to her mentor for guiding her career.
example_cn: 她很感激导师对她的职业指导。
etymology: 希腊语 Mentōr，荷马史诗中奥德修斯的忠实顾问

example_en: The store offers a wide range of merchandise at competitive prices.
example_cn: 这家商店以有竞争力的价格提供各种商品。
etymology: 法语 marchandise，意为"商品"

example_en: The prisoner begged for mercy from the judge.
example_cn: 囚犯向法官乞求宽恕。
etymology: 拉丁语 merces，意为"报酬"，后引申为宽恕

example_en: The two companies decided to merge to increase their market share.
example_cn: 两家公司决定合并以增加市场份额。
etymology: 拉丁语 mergere，意为"浸入"

meaning: n. 优点；功绩 v. 值得
example_en: The proposal has considerable merit and should be considered.
example_cn: 这个提议有相当大的优点，应该予以考虑。
etymology: 拉丁语 meritum，意为"值得"

example_en: Exercise can boost your metabolism and help burn calories.
example_cn: 运动可以促进新陈代谢，帮助燃烧卡路里。
etymology: 希腊语 metabole，意为"变化"

example_en: The poet used the metaphor of a river to represent the passage of time.
example_cn: 诗人用河流的隐喻来表示时间的流逝。
etymology: 希腊语 metaphora，意为"转移"

example_en: The metropolitan area has a population of over ten million.
example_cn: 大都市区有超过一千万人口。
etymology: 希腊语 mētēr（母亲）+ polis（城市），意为"母城"

example_en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
example_cn: 许多鸟类冬季南迁。
etymology: 拉丁语 migrare，意为"迁移"

example_en: The successful launch was a milestone in the space program.
example_cn: 成功的发射是太空计划中的一个里程碑。
etymology: 道路上的里程碑

meaning: adj. 激进的 n. 激进分子
example_en: Militant groups protested against the new law.
example_cn: 激进团体抗议新法律。
etymology: 拉丁语 militare，意为"服兵役"

meaning: v. 模仿 n. 模仿者
example_en: The parrot can mimic human speech remarkably well.
example_cn: 这只鹦鹉能非常出色地模仿人类说话。
etymology: 希腊语 mimos，意为"模仿者"

example_en: We need to minimize the environmental impact of the project.
example_cn: 我们需要将项目对环境的影响最小化。
etymology: 拉丁语 minimus，意为"最小的"

example_en: The Ministry of Education announced new reforms for schools.
example_cn: 教育部宣布了学校的新改革方案。
etymology: 拉丁语 ministerium，意为"服务；部"

example_en: It was a miracle that everyone survived the crash.
example_cn: 所有人都在坠机事故中幸存下来，这简直是个奇迹。
etymology: 拉丁语 miraculum，意为"奇迹"

example_en: Social mobility has declined in many developed countries.
example_cn: 许多发达国家的流动性有所下降。
etymology: 拉丁语 mobilis，意为"可移动的"

meaning: adj. 适度的；温和的 v. 节制
example_en: He holds moderate views on most political issues.
example_cn: 他对大多数政治问题持温和观点。
etymology: 拉丁语 moderatus，意为"有节制的"

example_en: The engineer modified the design to improve efficiency.
example_cn: 工程师修改了设计以提高效率。
etymology: 拉丁语 modificare，意为"限制；调整"

example_en: A water molecule consists of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
example_cn: 一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。
etymology: 拉丁语 molecula，意为"小量"

example_en: The campaign is gaining momentum as more people join the cause.
example_cn: 随着更多人加入这一事业，运动正获得动力。
etymology: 拉丁语 momentum，意为"运动；重要性"

example_en: The monarch ruled the kingdom for over forty years.
example_cn: 这位君主统治王国超过四十年。
etymology: 希腊语 monos（单一）+ arkhēs（统治者）

example_en: The company holds a monopoly on the local telecommunications market.
example_cn: 该公司在当地电信市场持有垄断地位。
etymology: 希腊语 monos（单一）+ pōlein（卖）

example_en: The team's morale was high after the victory.
example_cn: 胜利后团队的士气很高。
etymology: 法语 morale，意为"道德；士气"

meaning: adj. 致命的；凡人的 n. 凡人
example_en: All humans are mortal and will eventually die.
example_cn: 所有人都是凡人，终有一死。
etymology: 拉丁语 mortalis，意为"必死的"

meaning: n. 抵押贷款 v. 抵押
example_en: They took out a mortgage to buy their first home.
example_cn: 他们贷款买房。
etymology: 法语 mort + gage，意为"死约"，若不还款则抵押物"死亡"

example_en: The municipal government invested in public transportation.
example_cn: 市政府投资了公共交通。
etymology: 拉丁语 municipalis，意为"属于城市的"

example_en: A murmur of disapproval spread through the audience.
example_cn: 不满的低语声在观众中蔓延开来。
etymology: 法语 murmure，意为"低语"

meaning: adj. 沉默的；哑的 v. 消音
example_en: He remained mute throughout the entire interrogation.
example_cn: 他在整个审讯过程中保持沉默。
etymology: 拉丁语 mutus，意为"哑的"

example_en: The two countries have mutual interests in maintaining peace.
example_cn: 两国在维护和平方面有共同利益。
etymology: 拉丁语 mutuus，意为"交换的"

distinction.diff: mutual 侧重双向互动；common 侧重共同拥有

example_en: There are myriad reasons why the project failed.
example_cn: 项目失败的原因有无数个。
etymology: 希腊语 myrias，意为"一万"

example_en: Greek mythology is full of fascinating stories about gods and heroes.
example_cn: 希腊神话充满了关于神和英雄的迷人故事。
etymology: 希腊语 mythologia，意为"讲故事"

example_en: It would be naive to think that the problem will solve itself.
example_cn: 认为问题会自行解决是天真的想法。
etymology: 法语 naïve，意为"天真的"，源自拉丁语 nativus（天然的）

meaning: n. 叙述；故事 adj. 叙述的
example_en: The documentary presents a compelling narrative about climate change.
example_cn: 这部纪录片呈现了关于气候变化的引人入胜的叙述。
etymology: 拉丁语 narrare，意为"讲述"

meaning: adj. 令人不快的；恶劣的
example_en: The weather turned nasty with heavy rain and strong winds.
example_cn: 天气变得恶劣，大雨狂风。
etymology: 中古英语，可能源自古诺斯语

example_en: The naval base is located on the southern coast.
example_cn: 海军基地位于南部海岸。
etymology: 拉丁语 navis，意为"船"

example_en: It can be difficult to navigate through the complex legal system.
example_cn: 在复杂的法律体系中导航可能很困难。
etymology: 拉丁语 navigare，意为"航行"

example_en: The expansion will necessitate hiring additional staff.
example_cn: 扩张将需要招聘额外的员工。
etymology: 拉丁语 necessitas，意为"需要"

example_en: The union is negotiating with management for better working conditions.
example_cn: 工会正在与管理层就改善工作条件进行谈判。
etymology: 拉丁语 negotiari，意为"做生意"

example_en: Switzerland has maintained a neutral stance in international conflicts.
example_cn: 瑞士在国际冲突中保持中立立场。
etymology: 拉丁语 neutralis，意为"中立的"

meaning: adj. 名义上的；微不足道的
example_en: He paid a nominal fee to join the club.
example_cn: 他付了微不足道的费用加入了俱乐部。
etymology: 拉丁语 nominalis，意为"关于名字的"

example_en: She was nominated for the award by her colleagues.
example_cn: 她被同事们提名获奖。
etymology: 拉丁语 nominare，意为"命名"

example_en: Respecting others' privacy is a social norm.
example_cn: 尊重他人隐私是一种社会规范。
etymology: 拉丁语 norma，意为"规矩；标准"

example_en: The scientist made notable contributions to the field of genetics.
example_cn: 这位科学家对遗传学领域做出了显著贡献。
etymology: 拉丁语 notabilis，意为"值得注意的"

example_en: She rejected the notion that money brings happiness.
example_cn: 她拒绝了金钱带来幸福的观念。
etymology: 拉丁语 notio，意为"概念"

example_en: The city is notorious for its traffic congestion.
example_cn: 这座城市因交通拥堵而臭名昭著。
etymology: 拉丁语 notorius，意为"众所周知的"

distinction.diff: notorious 是贬义的出名；famous 是褒义的出名

example_en: Proper nutrition is essential to nourish the growing child.
example_cn: 适当的营养对滋养成长中的孩子至关重要。
etymology: 拉丁语 nutrire，意为"喂养"

meaning: n. 小说 adj. 新颖的
example_en: The researcher proposed a novel approach to the problem.
example_cn: 研究人员提出了一种解决该问题的新方法。
etymology: 拉丁语 novus，意为"新的"

distinction.diff: novel 强调创新独特；new 仅指时间上新的

example_en: The novice skier fell several times on the beginner slope.
example_cn: 这位滑雪新手在初级坡道上摔倒了好几次。
etymology: 拉丁语 novus，意为"新的"

meaning: n. 细微差别；微妙之处
example_en: The translator tried to capture the nuances of the original text.
example_cn: 翻译试图捕捉原文的微妙之处。
etymology: 法语 nuance，源自 nue（云），意为"微妙变化"

example_en: The data was analyzed using numerical methods.
example_cn: 数据使用了数值方法进行分析。
etymology: 拉丁语 numerus，意为"数字"

example_en: Parents should nurture their children's curiosity and creativity.
example_cn: 父母应该培养孩子的好奇心和创造力。
etymology: 拉丁语 nutrire，意为"喂养"

distinction.diff: nurture 指后天培养；nature 指先天本性

example_en: Plants absorb nutrients from the soil through their roots.
example_cn: 植物通过根部从土壤中吸收养分。
etymology: 拉丁语 nutrire，意为"滋养"

example_en: The witness took an oath to tell the truth in court.
example_cn: 证人在法庭上宣誓说实话。
etymology: 古英语 āth，意为"誓言"

example_en: Obese individuals are at higher risk for heart disease.
example_cn: 肥胖者患心脏病的风险更高。
etymology: 拉丁语 obesus，意为"肥胖的"

example_en: The law obliges employers to provide safe working conditions.
example_cn: 法律要求雇主提供安全的工作条件。
etymology: 拉丁语 obligare，意为"绑定"

meaning: adj. 模糊的；不出名的 v. 使模糊
example_en: The meaning of the ancient text remains obscure to scholars.
example_cn: 古文的含义对学者来说仍然模糊不清。
etymology: 拉丁语 obscurus，意为"黑暗的"

example_en: Typewriters have become obsolete in the digital age.
example_cn: 打字机在数字时代已经过时了。
etymology: 拉丁语 obsolescere，意为"衰退"

distinction.diff: obsolete 指已过时；obsolescent 指正在过时

example_en: Lack of funding is the main obstacle to the project.
example_cn: 缺乏资金是项目的主要障碍。
etymology: 拉丁语 obstare，意为"站在对面"

example_en: He was obstinate and refused to change his mind.
example_cn: 他很固执，拒绝改变主意。
etymology: 拉丁语 obstinare，意为"坚决反对"

distinction.diff: obstinate 更强调不顾理由地坚持；stubborn 更常用

example_en: The fallen tree obstructed the road for several hours.
example_cn: 倒下的树阻塞了道路好几个小时。
etymology: 拉丁语 obstruere，意为"建造在前面"

meaning: adj. 冒犯的；攻击性的 n. 攻势
example_en: The general launched a major offensive against the enemy.
example_cn: 将军对敌人发动了大规模攻势。
etymology: 拉丁语 offendere，意为"打击；冒犯"

meaning: v. 抵消；补偿 n. 偏移
example_en: The company planted trees to offset its carbon emissions.
example_cn: 公司种树以抵消其碳排放。
etymology: 由 off + set 组成

example_en: The animal protects its offspring from predators.
example_cn: 动物保护它的后代免受捕食者的伤害。
etymology: 古英语 of + springan，意为"跳出来"

example_en: Please do not omit any important details in your report.
example_cn: 请在报告中不要遗漏任何重要细节。
etymology: 拉丁语 omittere，意为"放走；省略"

example_en: The opaque glass prevents anyone from seeing inside.
example_cn: 不透明的玻璃阻止了任何人看到里面。
etymology: 拉丁语 opacus，意为"阴暗的"

example_en: She defeated her opponent in the chess tournament.
example_cn: 她在国际象棋锦标赛中击败了对手。
etymology: 拉丁语 opponere，意为"反对"

example_en: The regime oppressed its citizens for decades.
example_cn: 该政权压迫公民数十年。
etymology: 拉丁语 opprimere，意为"压下去"

example_en: Her optimism helped the team stay motivated during difficult times.
example_cn: 她的乐观帮助团队在困难时期保持动力。
etymology: 拉丁语 optimus，意为"最好的"

meaning: adj. 最佳的 n. 最佳条件
example_en: The plant grows best under optimum conditions of light and moisture.
example_cn: 该植物在最佳光照和湿度条件下生长最好。
etymology: 拉丁语 optimum，意为"最好的"

meaning: n. 轨道 v. 绕轨道运行
example_en: The satellite orbits the Earth every 90 minutes.
example_cn: 卫星每90分钟绕地球运行一圈。
etymology: 拉丁语 orbita，意为"轨道"

example_en: The hostages endured a terrifying ordeal during the siege.
example_cn: 人质在围困期间经历了可怕的煎熬。
etymology: 古英语 ordāl，意为"审判"，原指神裁法

meaning: v. 使适应；使朝向 n. 东方
example_en: The program helps new students orient themselves to campus life.
example_cn: 该项目帮助新生适应校园生活。
etymology: 拉丁语 oriens，意为"日出"

example_en: He holds orthodox views on education and discipline.
example_cn: 他对教育和纪律持传统观点。
etymology: 希腊语 orthos（正确）+ doxa（意见）

example_en: The outbreak of war displaced thousands of civilians.
example_cn: 战争爆发导致数千平民流离失所。
etymology: 由 out + break 组成

example_en: The outcome of the election surprised many analysts.
example_cn: 选举的结果让许多分析人士感到意外。
etymology: 由 out + come 组成

meaning: n. 愤怒；暴行 v. 激怒
example_en: The public expressed outrage at the government's decision.
example_cn: 公众对政府的决定表示愤怒。
etymology: 法语 outrage，意为"暴行"

example_en: They live on the outskirts of the city near the countryside.
example_cn: 他们住在城市郊区靠近乡村的地方。
etymology: 由 out + skirts 组成

example_en: The benefits of the project outweigh the costs.
example_cn: 项目的收益超过了成本。
etymology: 由 out + weigh 组成

meaning: v. 溢出；泛滥 n. 溢出
example_en: The river overflowed its banks after the heavy rain.
example_cn: 大雨后河水漫过了堤岸。
etymology: 由 over + flow 组成

example_en: There is some overlap between the two research projects.
example_cn: 两个研究项目之间有一些重叠。
etymology: 由 over + lap 组成

meaning: v. 使超载 n. 超载
example_en: The system crashed due to information overload.
example_cn: 系统因信息过载而崩溃。
etymology: 由 over + load 组成

example_en: The manager overlooked the minor mistake in the report.
example_cn: 经理忽视了报告中的小错误。
etymology: 由 over + look 组成

distinction.diff: overlook 指忽略或俯瞰；oversee 指监督

example_en: A committee was set up to oversee the implementation of the policy.
example_cn: 成立了一个委员会来监督政策的实施。
etymology: 由 over + see 组成

example_en: There was no overt sign of hostility between the two groups.
example_cn: 两组之间没有公开的敌意迹象。
etymology: 法语 overt，意为"开放的"

example_en: The rebels attempted to overthrow the government.
example_cn: 叛军试图推翻政府。
etymology: 由 over + throw 组成

example_en: She was overwhelmed by the generous support from her friends.
example_cn: 她被朋友们的慷慨支持所感动。
etymology: 由 over + whelm（覆盖）组成

meaning: adj. 压倒性的；势不可挡的
example_en: The evidence against the defendant was overwhelming.
example_cn: 对被告不利的证据是压倒性的。
etymology: overwhelm 的现在分词作形容词

example_en: The two countries signed a non-aggression pact.
example_cn: 两国签署了互不侵犯条约。
etymology: 拉丁语 pactum，意为"协议"

example_en: The tourist information center provides pamphlets about local attractions.
example_cn: 游客信息中心提供关于当地景点的小册子。
etymology: 拉丁语 pamphilus，一种爱情诗标题，后指小册子

example_en: The hilltop offers a panoramic view of the entire valley.
example_cn: 山顶可以俯瞰整个山谷的全景。
etymology: 希腊语 pan（全部）+ horama（视野）

example_en: It is a paradox that the busiest people often get the most done.
example_cn: 最忙的人往往完成最多的事，这是一个悖论。
etymology: 希腊语 paradoxon，意为"意外的；矛盾的"

meaning: adj. 平行的 n. 平行线；相似处
example_en: There are clear parallels between the two historical events.
example_cn: 这两个历史事件之间有明显的相似之处。
etymology: 希腊语 parallēlos，意为"并行的"

example_en: The strike paralyzed the city's transportation system.
example_cn: 罢工使城市的交通系统瘫痪。
etymology: 希腊语 paralyein，意为"松弛"

example_en: The experiment was conducted within strict parameters.
example_cn: 实验在严格的参数范围内进行。
etymology: 希腊语 para（旁）+ metron（测量）

meaning: adj. 最重要的；至高无上的
example_en: Safety is of paramount importance in the nuclear industry.
example_cn: 安全在核工业中是最重要的。
etymology: 法语 paramont，意为"在上方"

example_en: Can you paraphrase this sentence in simpler words?
example_cn: 你能用更简单的语言改写这个句子吗？
etymology: 希腊语 paraphrazein，意为"换种方式说"

example_en: The parasite feeds on the nutrients of its host.
example_cn: 寄生虫以宿主的营养为食。
etymology: 希腊语 parasitos，意为"在旁进食者"

meaning: n. 分割；隔板 v. 分割
example_en: The room was divided by a glass partition.
example_cn: 房间被玻璃隔板分开了。
etymology: 拉丁语 partitio，意为"分开"

example_en: She has a passion for music and plays the piano every day.
example_cn: 她对音乐充满热情，每天弹钢琴。
etymology: 拉丁语 passio，意为"受苦；情感"

example_en: He took a passive role in the discussion and rarely spoke.
example_cn: 他在讨论中扮演被动角色，很少发言。
etymology: 拉丁语 passivus，意为"承受的"

meaning: n. 专利 v. 取得专利
example_en: The company applied for a patent on its new invention.
example_cn: 公司为其新发明申请了专利。
etymology: 拉丁语 patere，意为"敞开"

example_en: The stray dog looked pathetic sitting in the rain.
example_cn: 流浪狗坐在雨中看起来很可怜。
etymology: 希腊语 pathetikos，意为"感受的；悲情的"

example_en: He was regarded as a patriot who fought for his country's freedom.
example_cn: 他被视为为祖国自由而战的爱国者。
etymology: 希腊语 patriōtēs，意为"同胞"

example_en: Security guards patrol the building every night.
example_cn: 保安每晚在楼内巡逻。
etymology: 法语 patrouille，意为"巡逻队"

example_en: The wealthy patron donated funds to support the arts.
example_cn: 那位富有的赞助人捐款支持艺术事业。
etymology: 拉丁语 patronus，意为"保护者"

example_en: Hard work paved the way for his success.
example_cn: 努力工作为他的成功铺平了道路。
etymology: 拉丁语 pavire，意为"踩实"

example_en: The dish has a peculiar taste that takes getting used to.
example_cn: 这道菜有一种奇怪的味道，需要适应。
etymology: 拉丁语 peculiaris，意为"私人财产"

meaning: n. 同龄人；同辈 v. 凝视
example_en: She was respected by her peers in the academic community.
example_cn: 她受到学术界同辈的尊重。
etymology: 拉丁语 par，意为"平等的"

example_en: The penalty for late payment is an additional five percent charge.
example_cn: 逾期付款的处罚是加收百分之五的费用。
etymology: 拉丁语 poena，意为"惩罚"

example_en: The sunlight could not penetrate the thick canopy of the forest.
example_cn: 阳光无法穿透森林茂密的树冠。
etymology: 拉丁语 penetrare，意为"进入"

example_en: She receives a monthly pension from the government.
example_cn: 她每月从政府领取养老金。
etymology: 拉丁语 pensio，意为"付款"

example_en: She perceived a slight change in his attitude.
example_cn: 她察觉到他的态度有了微妙的变化。
etymology: 拉丁语 percipere，意为"抓住；理解"

example_en: The expedition faced great perils in the uncharted wilderness.
example_cn: 探险队在未知的荒野中面临巨大危险。
etymology: 拉丁语 periculum，意为"试验；危险"

example_en: Many crops perished in the extreme drought.
example_cn: 许多庄稼在极端干旱中枯死了。
etymology: 拉丁语 perire，意为"走到底；灭亡"

example_en: The damage to the environment may be permanent.
example_cn: 对环境的损害可能是永久的。
etymology: 拉丁语 permanere，意为"持续到终点"

distinction.diff: permanent 侧重不变；perpetual 侧重持续不断

example_en: The smell of coffee permeated the entire office.
example_cn: 咖啡的香味弥漫了整个办公室。
etymology: 拉丁语 permeare，意为"穿过"

example_en: The region is in a state of perpetual conflict.
example_cn: 该地区处于持续不断的冲突中。
etymology: 拉丁语 perpetuus，意为"持续的"

example_en: The complex puzzle perplexed even the most experienced players.
example_cn: 这个复杂的谜题甚至让最有经验的玩家也感到困惑。
etymology: 拉丁语 perplexus，意为"纠缠的"

example_en: Religious minorities were persecuted during the regime.
example_cn: 宗教少数群体在该政权期间遭到迫害。
etymology: 拉丁语 persequi，意为"追踪；迫害"

distinction.diff: persecute 指迫害；prosecute 指起诉

example_en: Despite the difficulties, she persisted in her research.
example_cn: 尽管困难重重，她仍坚持研究。
etymology: 拉丁语 persistere，意为"坚定站立"

distinction.diff: persist 可中性或贬义；persevere 总是褒义

example_en: The documentary offers a fresh perspective on the issue.
example_cn: 这部纪录片提供了对该问题的新视角。
etymology: 拉丁语 perspicere，意为"看透"

example_en: Through gentle persuasion, she convinced him to change his mind.
example_cn: 通过温和的劝说，她说服他改变了主意。
etymology: 拉丁语 persuadere，意为"说服"

example_en: Please limit your comments to matters pertinent to the agenda.
example_cn: 请将您的评论限于与议程相关的事项。
etymology: 拉丁语 pertinere，意为"涉及"

example_en: Social media has a pervasive influence on young people.
example_cn: 社交媒体对年轻人有普遍的影响。
etymology: 拉丁语 pervadere，意为"蔓延"

meaning: n. 请愿书 v. 请愿
example_en: Residents signed a petition to stop the construction project.
example_cn: 居民签署了请愿书以阻止建设项目。
etymology: 拉丁语 petitio，意为"请求"

example_en: They argued over petty matters instead of focusing on the real issues.
example_cn: 他们在琐事上争吵，而不是关注真正的问题。
etymology: 法语 petit，意为"小的"

example_en: You can buy the medicine at any local pharmacy.
example_cn: 你可以在任何当地药房买到这种药。
etymology: 希腊语 pharmakon，意为"药物"

example_en: The needle pierced through the fabric easily.
example_cn: 针很容易穿透布料。
etymology: 拉丁语 pertundere，意为"穿透"

example_en: Winning the Nobel Prize was the pinnacle of her career.
example_cn: 获得诺贝尔奖是她事业的顶峰。
etymology: 拉丁语 pinnaculum，意为"小尖塔"

meaning: n. 瘟疫；灾害 v. 折磨
example_en: The region was plagued by drought and famine.
example_cn: 该地区遭受干旱和饥荒的折磨。
etymology: 拉丁语 plaga，意为"打击；瘟疫"

example_en: The plight of the refugees drew international attention.
example_cn: 难民的困境引起了国际关注。
etymology: 中古英语 plight，意为"誓言"，后演变为困境

example_en: The invaders plundered the city's wealth and resources.
example_cn: 入侵者掠夺了城市的财富和资源。
etymology: 中古高地德语 plundern，意为"拿走家具"

meaning: v. 投入；暴跌 n. 跳水
example_en: Stock prices plunged after the announcement of the crisis.
example_cn: 危机公告发布后股价暴跌。
etymology: 拉丁语 plumbum，意为"铅"，plunge 原指铅垂下落

meaning: adj. 极地的；截然对立的
example_en: The two politicians hold polar opposite views on the issue.
example_cn: 两位政治家在这个问题上持截然对立的观点。
etymology: 拉丁语 polus，意为"极"

example_en: She sat by the window and pondered her next move.
example_cn: 她坐在窗边思考下一步行动。
etymology: 拉丁语 ponderare，意为"称重"

example_en: The policy was unpopular with the general populace.
example_cn: 该政策在普通民众中不受欢迎。
etymology: 拉丁语 populus，意为"人民"

example_en: China is the most populous country in the world.
example_cn: 中国是世界上人口最多的国家。
etymology: 拉丁语 populosus，意为"人口众多的"

example_en: The film portrays the struggles of immigrant families.
example_cn: 这部电影描绘了移民家庭的挣扎。
etymology: 拉丁语 protrahere，意为"拉出；描绘"

example_en: The meeting has been postponed until next Monday.
example_cn: 会议已推迟到下周一。
etymology: 拉丁语 postponere，意为"放在后面"

example_en: The drug is a potent remedy for severe pain.
example_cn: 这种药物是治疗剧痛的有效药物。
etymology: 拉丁语 potens，意为"有力的"

example_en: The museum has an impressive collection of ancient pottery.
example_cn: 博物馆收藏了大量令人印象深刻的古代陶器。
etymology: 拉丁语 potare，意为"饮用"，pottery 原指饮器

example_en: She is an experienced medical practitioner with twenty years of practice.
example_cn: 她是一位有二十年经验的执业医生。
etymology: 拉丁语 practicare，意为"实践"

example_en: The company's financial situation is precarious at best.
example_cn: 公司的财务状况充其量也是不稳定的。
etymology: 拉丁语 precarius，意为"通过祈求得到的"

example_en: A short introduction will precede the main speaker's address.
example_cn: 简短的介绍将在主讲人演讲之前进行。
etymology: 拉丁语 praecedere，意为"走在前面"

example_en: The court decision set a new precedent for similar cases.
example_cn: 法院的裁决为类似案件树立了新的先例。
etymology: 拉丁语 praecedere，意为"走在前面"

example_en: His injury precluded him from participating in the tournament.
example_cn: 他的伤势阻止了他参加锦标赛。
etymology: 拉丁语 pracludere，意为"关在前面"

example_en: The new CEO implemented changes that her predecessor had avoided.
example_cn: 新任CEO实施了她的前任所回避的变革。
etymology: 拉丁语 praedecessor，意为"先走的人"

meaning: adj. 占主导地位的；显著的
example_en: English is the predominant language in international business.
example_cn: 英语是国际商务中的主导语言。
etymology: 拉丁语 praedominari，意为"占优势"

example_en: In this region, agriculture predominates over industry.
example_cn: 在这个地区，农业比工业占优势。
etymology: 拉丁语 praedominari，意为"占优势"

meaning: adj. 初步的；预备的 n. 初步行动
example_en: The preliminary results of the study are very promising.
example_cn: 研究的初步结果非常有前景。
etymology: 拉丁语 praeliminaris，意为"在门槛之前的"

example_en: It would be premature to draw conclusions at this stage.
example_cn: 在这个阶段下结论还为时过早。
etymology: 拉丁语 praematurus，意为"过早的"

meaning: adj. 首位的 n. 总理
example_en: The country's premier university attracts students worldwide.
example_cn: 该国首屈一指的大学吸引了全球学生。
etymology: 法语 premier，意为"第一"

example_en: The argument is based on the premise that all people are equal.
example_cn: 这个论点基于所有人平等的前提。
etymology: 拉丁语 praemittere，意为"预先发送"

meaning: n. 保险费；额外费用 adj. 优质的
example_en: You have to pay a premium for organic food.
example_cn: 你必须为有机食品支付额外费用。
etymology: 拉丁语 praemium，意为"奖赏"

example_en: The doctor prescribed antibiotics for the infection.
example_cn: 医生为感染开了抗生素。
etymology: 拉丁语 praescribere，意为"预先写好"

distinction.diff: prescribe 指规定/开处方；proscribe 指禁止

example_en: The judge presided over the trial with great authority.
example_cn: 法官以极大的权威主持了审判。
etymology: 拉丁语 praesidere，意为"坐在前面"

example_en: The university has considerable prestige in the academic world.
example_cn: 这所大学在学术界享有相当高的声望。
etymology: 法语 prestige，意为"幻觉；魅力"

example_en: I presume you have read the report before the meeting.
example_cn: 我假定你在会议前已经读了报告。
etymology: 拉丁语 praesumere，意为"预先拿取"

distinction.diff: presume 有更多依据；assume 更随意

example_en: Justice will prevail in the end.
example_cn: 正义终将获胜。
etymology: 拉丁语 praevalere，意为"更强大"

example_en: The disease is prevalent in tropical regions.
example_cn: 这种疾病在热带地区很普遍。
etymology: 拉丁语 praevalere，意为"更强大"

meaning: n. 猎物 v. 捕食
example_en: The owl hunts its prey at night.
example_cn: 猫头鹰在夜间捕食猎物。
etymology: 拉丁语 praeda，意为"猎物"

meaning: v. 刺；扎 n. 刺痛
example_en: She pricked her finger on the rose thorn.
example_cn: 她被玫瑰刺扎了手指。
etymology: 古英语 prician，意为"刺"

example_en: The tribe still lives in primitive conditions without electricity.
example_cn: 该部落仍生活在没有电的原始条件中。
etymology: 拉丁语 primus，意为"第一"

example_en: Access to quality education should not be a privilege of the wealthy.
example_cn: 获得优质教育不应是富人的特权。
etymology: 拉丁语 privilegium，意为"适用于个人的法律"

meaning: v. 探查 n. 探针；调查
example_en: The journalist probed into the politician's financial dealings.
example_cn: 记者调查了这位政治家的财务交易。
etymology: 拉丁语 probare，意为"检验"

example_en: The president proclaimed a national day of mourning.
example_cn: 总统宣布了一个全国哀悼日。
etymology: 拉丁语 proclamare，意为"大声呼喊"

example_en: Stop procrastinating and start working on the assignment.
example_cn: 别再拖延了，开始做作业吧。
etymology: 拉丁语 pro- + crastinus（明天的），意为"推到明天"

example_en: The company procured raw materials from local suppliers.
example_cn: 公司从当地供应商采购了原材料。
etymology: 拉丁语 procurare，意为"照料；获取"

example_en: The book had a profound impact on my understanding of the world.
example_cn: 这本书对我的世界观产生了深刻影响。
etymology: 拉丁语 profundus，意为"深的"

example_en: The law prohibits the sale of alcohol to minors.
example_cn: 法律禁止向未成年人销售酒精。
etymology: 拉丁语 prohibere，意为"阻止"

example_en: The negotiations were prolonged due to disagreements on key issues.
example_cn: 由于在关键问题上存在分歧，谈判被延长了。
etymology: 拉丁语 prolongare，意为"向前延伸"

example_en: She is a prominent figure in the field of artificial intelligence.
example_cn: 她是人工智能领域的杰出人物。
etymology: 拉丁语 prominere，意为"突出"

example_en: The region is prone to earthquakes and volcanic eruptions.
example_cn: 该地区易于发生地震和火山喷发。
etymology: 拉丁语 pronus，意为"向前倾斜的"

example_en: The government used propaganda to influence public opinion.
example_cn: 政府利用宣传来影响公众舆论。
etymology: 拉丁语 propagare，意为"传播"

example_en: The organization aims to propagate knowledge about environmental protection.
example_cn: 该组织旨在传播环境保护知识。
etymology: 拉丁语 propagare，意为"繁殖；传播"

example_en: Ambition propelled him to work harder and achieve his goals.
example_cn: 雄心驱使他更加努力地工作以实现目标。
etymology: 拉丁语 propellere，意为"向前推"

example_en: A large proportion of the population lives below the poverty line.
example_cn: 很大一部分人口生活在贫困线以下。
etymology: 拉丁语 proportio，意为"比例"

example_en: The business proposition was rejected by the board of directors.
example_cn: 商业提议被董事会拒绝了。
etymology: 拉丁语 propositio，意为"陈述"

example_en: The district attorney decided to prosecute the case.
example_cn: 地方检察官决定起诉此案。
etymology: 拉丁语 prosequi，意为"追随"

example_en: The university offers tours for prospective students.
example_cn: 大学为有意向的学生提供参观。
etymology: 拉丁语 prospicere，意为"向前看"

example_en: The town prospered after the new factory opened.
example_cn: 新工厂开业后小镇繁荣起来。
etymology: 拉丁语 prosperare，意为"使成功"

example_en: The country enjoyed a period of unprecedented prosperity.
example_cn: 该国经历了一段前所未有的繁荣时期。
etymology: 拉丁语 prosperitas，意为"好运"

example_en: Diplomatic protocol requires a formal greeting between leaders.
example_cn: 外交礼仪要求领导人之间进行正式问候。
etymology: 希腊语 protokollon，意为"第一页粘贴的标签"

example_en: The engineers built a prototype of the new device for testing.
example_cn: 工程师们制造了新设备的原型进行测试。
etymology: 希腊语 prototypon，意为"原始模型"

example_en: As the proverb says, practice makes perfect.
example_cn: 正如谚语所说，熟能生巧。
etymology: 拉丁语 proverbium，意为"俗语"

example_en: The contract includes a provision for early termination.
example_cn: 合同包含提前终止的规定。
etymology: 拉丁语 providere，意为"预见；准备"

example_en: The artist created a provocative piece that challenged social norms.
example_cn: 艺术家创作了一件挑战社会规范的挑衅作品。
etymology: 拉丁语 provocare，意为"挑战"

example_en: His rude comments provoked an angry response from the audience.
example_cn: 他的粗鲁言论引起了观众的愤怒反应。
etymology: 拉丁语 provocare，意为"召唤；挑战"

example_en: It would be prudent to save money for unexpected expenses.
example_cn: 为意外支出存钱是明智的。
etymology: 拉丁语 providere，意为"预见"

example_en: The war had a severe psychological impact on the soldiers.
example_cn: 战争对士兵产生了严重的心理影响。
etymology: 希腊语 psykhē，意为"灵魂"

example_en: The system is designed to purify drinking water.
example_cn: 该系统旨在净化饮用水。
etymology: 拉丁语 purus，意为"纯净的"

example_en: She has the right qualifications for the job.
example_cn: 她具备这份工作所需的资格。
etymology: 拉丁语 qualificare，意为"使具有资格"

example_en: It is difficult to quantify the exact impact of the policy.
example_cn: 很难量化政策的确切影响。
etymology: 拉丁语 quantus，意为"多少"

example_en: The scientist spent a lifetime on the quest for knowledge.
example_cn: 这位科学家一生追求知识。
etymology: 拉丁语 quaerere，意为"寻找"

example_en: The country has set a quota on imports of foreign cars.
example_cn: 该国对进口外国汽车设定了配额。
etymology: 拉丁语 quota pars，意为"多少份"

meaning: adj. 根本的；激进的 n. 激进分子
example_en: The company needs radical changes to stay competitive.
example_cn: 公司需要根本性的变革才能保持竞争力。
etymology: 拉丁语 radix，意为"根"

meaning: n. 愤怒 v. 发怒
example_en: He flew into a rage when he heard the news.
example_cn: 他听到消息时勃然大怒。
etymology: 拉丁语 rabies，意为"疯狂"

example_en: Police carried out a raid on the suspected drug house.
example_cn: 警方对涉嫌毒品交易的房子进行了突击搜查。
etymology: 中古英语 raid，意为"骑行袭击"

meaning: v. 集合；恢复 n. 集会
example_en: Supporters rallied outside the parliament building.
example_cn: 支持者们在议会大楼外集会。
etymology: 法语 rallier，意为"重新联合"

meaning: adj. 鲁莽的 n. 皮疹
example_en: Don't make rash decisions when you are angry.
example_cn: 愤怒时不要做鲁莽的决定。
etymology: 古英语 ræsc，意为"急速的"

example_en: The senate voted to ratify the international treaty.
example_cn: 参议院投票批准了国际条约。
etymology: 拉丁语 ratificare，意为"使确定"

meaning: n. 配给量 v. 配给
example_en: Food and water were rationed during the emergency.
example_cn: 紧急时期食品和水实行配给制。
etymology: 拉丁语 ratio，意为"计算；理由"

example_en: This discovery opens up new possibilities in the realm of science.
example_cn: 这一发现在科学领域开辟了新的可能性。
etymology: 法语 realme，意为"王国"

example_en: You reap what you sow in life.
example_cn: 生活中种瓜得瓜，种豆得豆。
etymology: 古英语 ripan，意为"收割"

example_en: The doctor reassured the patient that the surgery would be successful.
example_cn: 医生让患者安心，手术会成功的。
etymology: 法语 rassurer，意为"使安心"

example_en: The rebellion was quickly suppressed by government forces.
example_cn: 叛乱被政府军迅速镇压。
etymology: 拉丁语 rebellare，意为"重新开战"

example_en: The country entered a deep recession following the financial crisis.
example_cn: 金融危机后该国陷入了严重的经济衰退。
etymology: 拉丁语 recessus，意为"退却"

example_en: She followed her grandmother's recipe to make the cake.
example_cn: 她按照祖母的食谱做蛋糕。
etymology: 拉丁语 recipe，意为"拿取"，处方开头语

example_en: The two countries signed a reciprocal trade agreement.
example_cn: 两国签署了互惠贸易协定。
etymology: 拉丁语 reciprocare，意为"来回移动"

example_en: I reckon it will take about three hours to get there.
example_cn: 我估计到那里大约需要三个小时。
etymology: 古英语 recenian，意为"计算"

example_en: The city plans to reclaim the abandoned industrial site for housing.
example_cn: 城市计划回收废弃的工业用地用于住房建设。
etymology: 拉丁语 reclamare，意为"叫喊；要求归还"

example_en: It is difficult to reconcile the two opposing viewpoints.
example_cn: 很难调和这两种对立的观点。
etymology: 拉丁语 reconciliare，意为"使再结合"

meaning: v. 招募 n. 新兵
example_en: The company is recruiting new employees for the overseas branch.
example_cn: 公司正在为海外分公司招募新员工。
etymology: 法语 recruter，意为"征募"

example_en: Several positions were made redundant due to budget cuts.
example_cn: 由于预算削减，几个职位被裁减了。
etymology: 拉丁语 redundare，意为"溢出"

example_en: The researcher refined the experiment to get more accurate results.
example_cn: 研究人员改进了实验以获得更准确的结果。
etymology: 拉丁语 refinare，意为"再提炼"

example_en: He presented evidence to refute the allegations against him.
example_cn: 他出示证据反驳对他的指控。
etymology: 拉丁语 refutare，意为"击退"

example_en: The military regime ruled the country for over a decade.
example_cn: 军事政权统治该国超过十年。
etymology: 法语 régime，意为"统治；制度"

example_en: Queen Victoria reigned over Britain for more than sixty years.
example_cn: 维多利亚女王统治英国超过六十年。
etymology: 拉丁语 regere，意为"引导；统治"

example_en: The evidence reinforces the theory that the universe is expanding.
example_cn: 证据加强了宇宙正在膨胀的理论。
etymology: 法语 renforcer，意为"加强"

meaning: v. 转播；传递 n. 接力
example_en: The satellite relayed the signal to ground stations.
example_cn: 卫星将信号转播到地面站。
etymology: 法语 relais，意为"接力"

example_en: What is the relevance of this information to the case?
example_cn: 这些信息与案件有什么关联？
etymology: 拉丁语 relevare，意为"举起；相关"

example_en: She is a reliable employee who always meets deadlines.
example_cn: 她是一位总是按时完成工作的可靠员工。
etymology: 拉丁语 religare，意为"绑紧"

meaning: n. 疗法；补救办法 v. 补救
example_en: The best remedy for a cold is rest and plenty of fluids.
example_cn: 治疗感冒最好的方法是休息和多喝水。
etymology: 拉丁语 remedium，意为"治愈"

example_en: Only remnants of the ancient wall still stand today.
example_cn: 如今只剩下古墙的残迹了。
etymology: 拉丁语 remanere，意为"留下"

example_en: The explosion rendered the building uninhabitable.
example_cn: 爆炸使建筑物无法居住。
etymology: 拉丁语 reddere，意为"归还；使成为"

example_en: The old hotel was renovated and reopened as a luxury resort.
example_cn: 旧酒店经过翻新后作为豪华度假村重新开业。
etymology: 拉丁语 renovare，意为"更新"

example_en: The city is renowned for its beautiful architecture.
example_cn: 这座城市以其美丽的建筑而闻名。
etymology: 法语 renommer，意为"使有名"

example_en: The army repelled the enemy's attack at the border.
example_cn: 军队在边境击退了敌人的进攻。
etymology: 拉丁语 repellere，意为"推回"

example_en: The pianist has a vast repertoire of classical music.
example_cn: 这位钢琴家拥有丰富的古典音乐曲目。
etymology: 法语 répertoire，意为"清单；仓库"

example_en: We need to replenish our supplies before the next expedition.
example_cn: 我们需要在下一次探险前补充物资。
etymology: 拉丁语 re- + plenus（满的）

example_en: She tried to repress her anger during the meeting.
example_cn: 她试图在会议中压抑自己的愤怒。
etymology: 拉丁语 reprimere，意为"压回去"

example_en: He looked at her with reproach for breaking the promise.
example_cn: 他责备地看着她，因为她违背了承诺。
etymology: 法语 reprocher，意为"责备"

example_en: She closely resembles her mother in appearance.
example_cn: 她的外貌很像她的母亲。
etymology: 法语 ressembler，意为"像"

example_en: He resented being treated unfairly by his supervisor.
example_cn: 他对被主管不公平对待感到愤恨。
etymology: 拉丁语 resentire，意为"再次感受"

example_en: The family resides in a small town outside the city.
example_cn: 这个家庭住在城外的一个小镇上。
etymology: 拉丁语 residere，意为"坐落"

example_en: The area is primarily residential with few commercial buildings.
example_cn: 该地区主要是住宅区，商业建筑很少。
etymology: 拉丁语 residere，意为"居住"

meaning: adj. 剩余的 n. 剩余
example_en: There may be some residual pain after the surgery.
example_cn: 手术后可能还会有一些残余的疼痛。
etymology: 拉丁语 residuus，意为"剩余的"

example_en: He resigned from his position due to health reasons.
example_cn: 他因健康原因辞去了职务。
etymology: 拉丁语 resignare，意为"解除；放弃"

meaning: adj. 有弹性的；适应力强的
example_en: Children are often more resilient than adults give them credit for.
example_cn: 孩子们往往比大人们认为的更有适应力。
etymology: 拉丁语 resilire，意为"弹回"

example_en: The UN passed a resolution condemning the attack.
example_cn: 联合国通过了一项谴责袭击的决议。
etymology: 拉丁语 resolvere，意为"解开；决定"

meaning: v. 求助 n. 度假胜地
example_en: As a last resort, they decided to take legal action.
example_cn: 作为最后手段，他们决定采取法律行动。
etymology: 法语 resortir，意为"再次出去"

example_en: The team members returned to their respective offices after the meeting.
example_cn: 会后团队成员回到了各自的办公室。
etymology: 拉丁语 respicere，意为"回头看"

example_en: The restoration of the old painting took several months.
example_cn: 修复这幅旧画花了几个月时间。
etymology: 拉丁语 restaurare，意为"重建"

example_en: She had to restrain herself from laughing during the ceremony.
example_cn: 她在仪式上不得不忍住不笑。
etymology: 拉丁语 restringere，意为"紧紧拉住"

example_en: The new law restricts the use of plastic bags in stores.
example_cn: 新法律限制商店使用塑料袋。
etymology: 拉丁语 restringere，意为"绑紧"

meaning: n./adj. 零售 v. 零售
example_en: The company sells its products through retail outlets nationwide.
example_cn: 公司通过全国零售店销售其产品。
etymology: 法语 retail，意为"切成小块"

example_en: The building retains many of its original architectural features.
example_cn: 这座建筑保留了许多原始建筑特色。
etymology: 拉丁语 retinere，意为"保持；留住"

example_en: She retrieved the lost file from the backup system.
example_cn: 她从备份系统中找回了丢失的文件。
etymology: 法语 retrouver，意为"再次找到"

example_en: The book contains some startling revelations about the president's past.
example_cn: 这本书包含了一些关于总统过去的惊人揭示。
etymology: 拉丁语 revelare，意为"揭开"

example_en: The government's revenue comes primarily from taxes.
example_cn: 政府的收入主要来自税收。
etymology: 拉丁语 revenire，意为"回来"，指回归的钱

meaning: v. 颠倒；反转 adj. 相反的 n. 相反
example_en: The court reversed the earlier decision.
example_cn: 法院推翻了先前的裁决。
etymology: 拉丁语 reversus，意为"转回"

example_en: The author revised the manuscript several times before publication.
example_cn: 作者在出版前多次修订了手稿。
etymology: 拉丁语 revisere，意为"再看"

example_en: The community is working to revive the traditional art form.
example_cn: 社区正在努力复兴传统艺术形式。
etymology: 拉丁语 revivere，意为"再活"

example_en: The debate revolves around the issue of climate change.
example_cn: 辩论围绕气候变化问题展开。
etymology: 拉丁语 revolvere，意为"滚回"

example_en: He faced ridicule from his classmates for his unusual idea.
example_cn: 他因不同寻常的想法遭到同学们的嘲笑。
etymology: 拉丁语 ridiculum，意为"笑料"

example_en: The scientific study followed rigorous research methods.
example_cn: 这项科学研究遵循了严格的研究方法。
etymology: 拉丁语 rigor，意为"僵硬；严格"

meaning: n. 暴乱 v. 暴乱
example_en: Riots broke out across the city after the controversial verdict.
example_cn: 有争议的裁决后城市各地爆发了暴乱。
etymology: 法语 riote，意为"争吵"

meaning: n. 仪式；惯例 adj. 仪式的
example_en: The tribe performs a traditional ritual before each harvest.
example_cn: 部落在每次收获前进行传统仪式。
etymology: 拉丁语 ritualis，意为"仪式的"

example_en: There is a long-standing rivalry between the two schools.
example_cn: 两校之间长期存在竞争关系。
etymology: 拉丁语 rivalis，意为"共用同一条溪流的人"

example_en: The economy showed robust growth in the third quarter.
example_cn: 经济在第三季度表现出强劲增长。
etymology: 拉丁语 robur，意为"橡木；力量"

meaning: n. 无赖 adj. 行为异常的
example_en: A rogue trader caused the bank to lose millions.
example_cn: 一个违规交易员导致银行损失了数百万。
etymology: 法语 rogo，意为"流浪汉"

example_en: The team members rotate their responsibilities each month.
example_cn: 团队成员每月轮流承担责任。
etymology: 拉丁语 rotare，意为"旋转"

meaning: n. 常规；惯例 adj. 例行的
example_en: She follows a daily routine of exercise and meditation.
example_cn: 她每天遵循锻炼和冥想的常规。
etymology: 法语 route，意为"道路"

example_en: The author receives a royalty for each book sold.
example_cn: 作者每卖出一本书就获得一笔版税。
etymology: 法语 roialté，意为"王权"

example_en: The pipe ruptured and caused flooding in the basement.
example_cn: 管道破裂导致地下室被淹。
etymology: 拉丁语 ruptura，意为"破裂"

example_en: The ruthless dictator showed no mercy to his opponents.
example_cn: 无情的独裁者对反对者毫不留情。
etymology: 古英语 rūth（怜悯）+ less，意为"无怜悯的"

example_en: The temple is considered a sacred place of worship.
example_cn: 这座寺庙被视为神圣的礼拜场所。
etymology: 拉丁语 sacer，意为"神圣的"

example_en: Parents often sacrifice their own comfort for their children.
example_cn: 父母经常为了孩子牺牲自己的舒适。
etymology: 拉丁语 sacrificium，意为"使之神圣"

meaning: n. 保护措施 v. 保护
example_en: New safeguards were implemented to protect consumers' data.
example_cn: 实施了新的保护措施来保护消费者数据。
etymology: 由 safe + guard 组成

meaning: v. 抢救；挽回 n. 抢救
example_en: They tried to salvage what they could from the damaged ship.
example_cn: 他们试图从受损的船上抢救出能用的东西。
etymology: 法语 salvager，意为"拯救"

meaning: n. 制裁；批准 v. 批准
example_en: The UN imposed economic sanctions on the country.
example_cn: 联合国对该国实施了经济制裁。
etymology: 拉丁语 sanctio，意为"法令"，兼有批准和惩罚两层含义

example_en: The wildlife sanctuary provides a safe home for endangered animals.
example_cn: 野生动物庇护所为濒危动物提供了安全的家园。
etymology: 拉丁语 sanctuarium，意为"神圣场所"

example_en: The market is saturated with similar products.
example_cn: 市场上充斥着类似的产品。
etymology: 拉丁语 saturare，意为"填满"

example_en: In the worst-case scenario, the company could go bankrupt.
example_cn: 在最坏的情况下，公司可能破产。
etymology: 意大利语 scenario，意为"舞台布景"

example_en: The proposal came under close scrutiny from the committee.
example_cn: 该提案受到了委员会的仔细审查。
etymology: 拉丁语 scrutari，意为"搜索"

meaning: n. 段；部分 v. 分割
example_en: The company targets a specific segment of the market.
example_cn: 公司瞄准了市场的特定细分领域。
etymology: 拉丁语 segmentum，意为"切割部分"

example_en: Waste should be segregated into recyclable and non-recyclable categories.
example_cn: 垃圾应分为可回收和不可回收两类。
etymology: 拉丁语 segregare，意为"分开放置"

example_en: She attended a seminar on leadership development last week.
example_cn: 她上周参加了一个关于领导力发展的研讨会。
etymology: 拉丁语 seminarium，意为"苗圃"，后引申为培养思想

example_en: The discovery caused a sensation in the scientific community.
example_cn: 这一发现在科学界引起了轰动。
etymology: 拉丁语 sensatio，意为"感觉"

example_en: Public sentiment was strongly against the proposed law.
example_cn: 公众舆论强烈反对拟议的法律。
etymology: 法语 sentiment，意为"感觉"

example_en: The events occurred in a logical sequence.
example_cn: 事件按逻辑顺序发生。
etymology: 拉丁语 sequi，意为"跟随"

example_en: The lake was serene in the early morning light.
example_cn: 清晨的湖面宁静安详。
etymology: 拉丁语 serenus，意为"晴朗的；平静的"

example_en: The training program simulates real-world emergency situations.
example_cn: 培训项目模拟了真实世界的紧急情况。
etymology: 拉丁语 simulare，意为"模仿"

example_en: The announcement was made in simultaneous broadcasts across all channels.
example_cn: 公告在所有频道同时播出。
etymology: 拉丁语 simul，意为"同时"

example_en: Archaeologists found a dinosaur skeleton in the desert.
example_cn: 考古学家在沙漠中发现了恐龙骨架。
etymology: 希腊语 skeletos，意为"干枯的"

example_en: Many scientists remain skeptical about the new theory.
example_cn: 许多科学家对新理论持怀疑态度。
etymology: 希腊语 skeptikos，意为"思考的；怀疑的"

example_en: Housing prices have soared in the past year.
example_cn: 过去一年房价飙升。
etymology: 拉丁语 exaurare，意为"向上飞"

example_en: He remained sober throughout the party and drove everyone home safely.
example_cn: 他在整个聚会中保持清醒，并安全送大家回家。
etymology: 拉丁语 sobrius，意为"清醒的"

example_en: She is studying sociology at the university.
example_cn: 她在大学学习社会学。
etymology: 拉丁语 socius（同伴）+ 希腊语 -logy（学科）

example_en: The ceremony was a solemn occasion attended by dignitaries.
example_cn: 仪式是一个庄严的场合，有政要出席。
etymology: 拉丁语 solemnis，意为"每年的；庄严的"

example_en: The charity solicited donations from local businesses.
example_cn: 慈善机构向当地企业募捐。
etymology: 拉丁语 sollicitare，意为"搅动；请求"

example_en: The workers showed solidarity by joining the protest together.
example_cn: 工人们团结一致地参加了抗议活动。
etymology: 法语 solidarité，意为"团结"

example_en: He led a solitary life in the remote cabin.
example_cn: 他在偏远的小木屋里过着孤独的生活。
etymology: 拉丁语 solitarius，意为"孤独的"

example_en: Sugar is soluble in water but not in oil.
example_cn: 糖溶于水但不溶于油。
etymology: 拉丁语 solvere，意为"松开；溶解"

example_en: The new software uses sophisticated algorithms for data analysis.
example_cn: 新软件使用复杂的算法进行数据分析。
etymology: 希腊语 sophos，意为"智慧的"

example_en: The country fiercely defends its sovereignty and territorial integrity.
example_cn: 该国坚决捍卫其主权和领土完整。
etymology: 法语 souveraineté，意为"最高权力"

meaning: n. 跨度；范围 v. 横跨
example_en: The bridge spans the wide river connecting the two cities.
example_cn: 这座桥横跨宽阔的河流，连接两座城市。
etymology: 古英语 spann，意为"跨度"

example_en: The architect has an excellent sense of spatial design.
example_cn: 这位建筑师有出色的空间设计感。
etymology: 拉丁语 spatium，意为"空间"

meaning: v. 产生；大量出现 n. 卵
example_en: The new technology spawned a whole industry of startups.
example_cn: 新技术催生了整个初创产业。
etymology: 中古英语，原指鱼产卵

example_en: The biologist collected a specimen of the rare butterfly.
example_cn: 生物学家采集了这种稀有蝴蝶的标本。
etymology: 拉丁语 specimen，意为"标志；样本"

example_en: The fireworks display was a magnificent spectacle.
example_cn: 烟花表演是一场壮观的景象。
etymology: 拉丁语 spectaculum，意为"观看"

example_en: The team achieved a spectacular victory in the championship.
example_cn: 球队在锦标赛中取得了惊人的胜利。
etymology: 源自 spectacle，意为"壮观"

example_en: Thousands of spectators lined the streets for the parade.
example_cn: 数千名观众沿街观看游行。
etymology: 拉丁语 spectare，意为"观看"

example_en: Analysts speculate that the company will announce a merger soon.
example_cn: 分析人士推测公司很快会宣布合并。
etymology: 拉丁语 speculari，意为"观察"

example_en: The issue falls within the sphere of international law.
example_cn: 这个问题属于国际法的范围。
etymology: 希腊语 sphaira，意为"球"

meaning: v. 溢出；洒出 n. 溢出
example_en: Oil spilled from the damaged tanker into the ocean.
example_cn: 石油从损坏的油轮中溢入海洋。
etymology: 古英语 spillan，意为"毁灭；溢出"

example_en: He injured his spine in the car accident.
example_cn: 他在车祸中伤了脊柱。
etymology: 拉丁语 spina，意为"刺；脊柱"

meaning: n. 螺旋 adj. 螺旋的 v. 螺旋式上升
example_en: The company's debt spiraled out of control.
example_cn: 公司的债务螺旋式上升失去了控制。
etymology: 拉丁语 spiralis，意为"盘绕的"

example_en: Many people find spiritual comfort in meditation and prayer.
example_cn: 许多人在冥想和祈祷中找到精神安慰。
etymology: 拉丁语 spiritus，意为"呼吸；精神"

meaning: n. 赞助者 v. 赞助
example_en: The event is sponsored by a major technology company.
example_cn: 活动由一家大型科技公司赞助。
etymology: 拉丁语 sponsus，意为"保证人"

example_en: The audience broke into spontaneous applause at the end of the performance.
example_cn: 表演结束后观众自发地鼓掌。
etymology: 拉丁语 sponte，意为"自愿地"

example_en: Employees and their spouses are invited to the company dinner.
example_cn: 员工及其配偶受邀参加公司晚宴。
etymology: 拉丁语 sponsus，意为"承诺；配偶"

meaning: v. 挤压；压榨 n. 挤压
example_en: She squeezed the lemon to get fresh juice.
example_cn: 她挤柠檬获取新鲜果汁。
etymology: 中古英语 queisen，意为"压"

example_en: Political stability is essential for economic growth.
example_cn: 政治稳定对经济增长至关重要。
etymology: 拉丁语 stabilis，意为"稳固的"

example_en: The economy has been stagnant for several years.
example_cn: 经济已经停滞了好几年。
etymology: 拉丁语 stagnare，意为"积水"

example_en: The company has a significant stake in the success of the project.
example_cn: 公司在项目成功中有重大利害关系。
etymology: 古英语 staca，意为"桩"

example_en: The government took a firm stance against corruption.
example_cn: 政府采取了坚决反腐败的立场。
etymology: 拉丁语 stans，意为"站立"

meaning: n. 主食；主要产品 adj. 主要的
example_en: Rice is a staple food in many Asian countries.
example_cn: 大米是许多亚洲国家的主食。
etymology: 中古英语 staple，意为"贸易中心"

example_en: There is a stark contrast between the rich and the poor in the city.
example_cn: 城市中贫富之间存在鲜明对比。
etymology: 古英语 stearc，意为"僵硬的"

example_en: The sudden noise startled the baby awake.
example_cn: 突然的噪音把婴儿吓醒了。
etymology: 古英语 steartlian，意为"急跳"

example_en: The car remained stationary at the traffic light.
example_cn: 汽车在红绿灯处保持静止。
etymology: 拉丁语 stationarius，意为"站立的"

distinction.diff: stationary 意为静止的；stationery 意为文具

example_en: The statute prohibits discrimination in the workplace.
example_cn: 法规禁止职场歧视。
etymology: 拉丁语 statutum，意为"规定"

example_en: The manager steered the company through the financial crisis.
example_cn: 经理引导公司度过了金融危机。
etymology: 古英语 stēoran，意为"掌舵"

meaning: n. 茎；词干 v. 起源；阻止
example_en: The problem stems from a lack of communication between departments.
example_cn: 问题源于部门之间缺乏沟通。
etymology: 古英语 stemn，意为"茎；干"

meaning: n. 刻板印象 v. 对…形成刻板印象
example_en: We should challenge stereotypes and treat people as individuals.
example_cn: 我们应该挑战刻板印象，将人们作为个体对待。
etymology: 法语 stéréotype，意为"固化印模"

meaning: adj. 严厉的；坚定的 n. 船尾
example_en: The teacher gave the student a stern warning about cheating.
example_cn: 老师对作弊的学生发出了严厉的警告。
etymology: 古英语 styrne，意为"严厉的"

example_en: The government hopes to stimulate economic growth with tax cuts.
example_cn: 政府希望通过减税刺激经济增长。
etymology: 拉丁语 stimulare，意为"刺激"

example_en: The contract stipulates that the work must be completed by December.
example_cn: 合同规定工作必须在十二月前完成。
etymology: 拉丁语 stipulari，意为"讨价还价"

meaning: n. 压力；拉紧 v. 拉紧；竭力
example_en: The long hours put a strain on his health.
example_cn: 长时间工作给他的健康带来了压力。
etymology: 拉丁语 stringere，意为"拉紧"

meaning: n. 股；线 v. 使搁浅
example_en: The hikers were stranded in the mountains by the sudden snowstorm.
example_cn: 徒步旅行者被突如其来的暴风雪困在山中。
etymology: 中古英语 strand，意为"绳股"

example_en: The company made a strategic decision to expand into Asian markets.
example_cn: 公司做出了拓展亚洲市场的战略决策。
etymology: 希腊语 strategia，意为"将道"

example_en: The company streamlined its operations to reduce costs.
example_cn: 公司简化了运营以降低成本。
etymology: stream + line，原指流线型设计

example_en: The athlete underwent strenuous training for the competition.
example_cn: 运动员为比赛进行了艰苦的训练。
etymology: 拉丁语 strenuus，意为"活跃的"

example_en: The region has been torn apart by civil strife for decades.
example_cn: 该地区几十年来一直被内乱所撕裂。
etymology: 法语 estrif，意为"争执"

example_en: The company strives to provide the best service to its customers.
example_cn: 公司努力为客户提供最好的服务。
etymology: 法语 estriver，意为"争吵；奋斗"

example_en: The building needs structural repairs after the earthquake.
example_cn: 地震后这座建筑需要结构性修缮。
etymology: 拉丁语 structura，意为"建造"

example_en: She stumbled over a rock while walking on the trail.
example_cn: 她在小路上行走时被石头绊倒了。
etymology: 古英语 styman，意为"绊倒"

example_en: The announcement stunned the entire audience.
example_cn: 公告让全场观众震惊。
etymology: 中古英语 stun，意为"使失去知觉"

example_en: The sturdy table can support heavy loads without breaking.
example_cn: 坚固的桌子可以承受重物而不破裂。
etymology: 中古英语 stout，意为"勇敢的；结实的"

example_en: The village was submerged by floodwaters after the storm.
example_cn: 暴风雨后村庄被洪水淹没。
etymology: 拉丁语 submergere，意为"沉入"

meaning: adj. 次要的 n. 下属 v. 使从属
example_en: The issue is subordinate to the main problem we are trying to solve.
example_cn: 这个问题从属于我们试图解决的主要问题。
etymology: 拉丁语 ordinare，意为"排列"

example_en: She subscribes to several academic journals in her field.
example_cn: 她订阅了所在领域的几本学术期刊。
etymology: 拉丁语 subscribere，意为"在下面签名"

example_en: Subsequent investigations revealed more evidence of fraud.
example_cn: 随后的调查揭示了更多欺诈证据。
etymology: 拉丁语 subsequi，意为"紧随其后"

meaning: n. 子公司 adj. 附属的
example_en: The company operates through several subsidiaries in different countries.
example_cn: 该公司通过在不同国家的几个子公司运营。
etymology: 拉丁语 subsidium，意为"援助；预备队"

example_en: The government provides subsidies to farmers to support agriculture.
example_cn: 政府向农民提供补贴以支持农业。
etymology: 拉丁语 subsidium，意为"援助"

example_en: The report lacks substance and provides no useful information.
example_cn: 报告缺乏实质内容，没有提供有用信息。
etymology: 拉丁语 substantia，意为"站在下面的东西；本质"

example_en: The company made a substantial investment in renewable energy.
example_cn: 公司在可再生能源方面进行了大量投资。
etymology: 拉丁语 substantialis，意为"实质的"

meaning: n. 替代品 v. 替代
example_en: You can use honey as a substitute for sugar in this recipe.
example_cn: 你可以在这道食谱中用蜂蜜代替糖。
etymology: 拉丁语 substituere，意为"放在下面代替"

example_en: There is a subtle difference between the two words.
example_cn: 这两个词之间有微妙的区别。
etymology: 拉丁语 subtilis，意为"精细的"

example_en: The group attempted to subvert the government through a secret coup.
example_cn: 该组织试图通过秘密政变颠覆政府。
etymology: 拉丁语 subvertere，意为"从下面翻转"

example_en: A succession of storms hit the coastal region last month.
example_cn: 上个月一系列风暴袭击了沿海地区。
etymology: 拉丁语 succedere，意为"接替"

example_en: She was appointed as the successor to the retiring CEO.
example_cn: 她被任命为即将退休的CEO的继任者。
etymology: 拉丁语 successor，意为"跟随者"

example_en: The customer decided to sue the company for false advertising.
example_cn: 顾客决定起诉公司虚假广告。
etymology: 法语 suir，意为"追随；起诉"

example_en: A brief explanation should suffice for now.
example_cn: 现在简要说明就够了。
etymology: 拉丁语 sufficere，意为"在下面放置；足够"

example_en: We have sufficient evidence to proceed with the case.
example_cn: 我们有充分的证据推进此案。
etymology: 拉丁语 sufficere，意为"足够"

example_en: World leaders gathered at the summit to discuss climate change.
example_cn: 世界各国领导人齐聚峰会讨论气候变化。
etymology: 法语 sommet，意为"顶部"

example_en: The court summoned the witness to testify.
example_cn: 法庭传唤证人作证。
etymology: 拉丁语 summonere，意为"暗示；召集"

example_en: Remove any superfluous words to make the essay more concise.
example_cn: 删去任何多余的词，使文章更简洁。
etymology: 拉丁语 superfluus，意为"溢出的"

meaning: adj. 优越的 n. 上司
example_en: The new product is superior to the old one in every way.
example_cn: 新产品在各方面都优于旧产品。
etymology: 拉丁语 superior，意为"更高的"

meaning: n. 补充 v. 补充
example_en: She takes vitamin supplements to maintain her health.
example_cn: 她服用维生素补充剂来维持健康。
etymology: 拉丁语 supplere，意为"填满"

example_en: The government suppressed the rebellion with military force.
example_cn: 政府以军事力量镇压了叛乱。
etymology: 拉丁语 suppressare，意为"压下"

example_en: The Supreme Court made the final ruling on the case.
example_cn: 最高法院对此案做出了最终裁决。
etymology: 拉丁语 supremus，意为"最高的"

example_en: There was a surge in demand for the product after the ad campaign.
example_cn: 广告活动后对该产品的需求激增。
etymology: 法语 sourdre，意为"涌出"

example_en: The young athlete surpassed all expectations in the competition.
example_cn: 这位年轻运动员在比赛中超越了所有人的期望。
etymology: 法语 surpasser，意为"超过"

example_en: The country has a trade surplus this year.
example_cn: 该国今年有贸易盈余。
etymology: 拉丁语 superplus，意为"多余"

meaning: adj. 易受影响的；敏感的
example_en: Young children are more susceptible to infections than adults.
example_cn: 幼儿比成人更容易感染。
etymology: 拉丁语 suscipere，意为"接受"

example_en: The company suspended the employee pending an investigation.
example_cn: 公司在调查期间暂停了该员工的职务。

example_cn: 魔术师让兔子凭空消失了。

example_en: Her vanity prevented her from admitting she was wrong.
example_cn: 她的虚荣心使她不愿承认自己错了。

meaning: adj. 多变的 n. 变量

meaning: n. 冒险；企业 v. 冒险

example_cn: 她是一位能演喜剧也能演正剧的多才多艺的女演员。
